blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.
blocks.zh: 专家的读者处理大量投入(例如代码寄存器和长文件),方法是略微只仔细阅读重要的内容。 另一方面,语言模型通过每个模型层处理所有输入符号,因此长文本输入的处理成本很高. 我们引入了TokenGate,这是一个小型的即用组件,它扩展了现有的训练有素的模型,使端到端的可学习符号能够浏览出长的文本输入,用于快速和内存高效的预填. 为了实现端到端的学习,尽管没有区别的上-K运算符来进行象征性的浏览,我们引入了有符号的注意,这个机制由Mixture-of-Experts所启发,利用象征性的重要性分来重新加权注意记录. 在各种任务中,TokenGate实现了1.4-11.3\times的较快时间与第一地标(TTFT)和1.5-3.4\times的较低峰值内存,对于变压器的预填没有精确降解. 相较于前作中表现最优的代币刷新方法,TokenGate放弃了6.4\times$更快的预填和2\times$更低的峰值内存. 键 门自为地延伸出标准变压器(如:Qun3)和混合调取模型(如:Qun3.5),简单的轻量级适应可与标准参数效率的微调相媲美. 我们在https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate提供我们的代码。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Long-context inputs underpin exciting recent language model deployments, where the model’s ability to process vast swaths of personalized user data and live content during inference has led to transformative capabilities in deep research, large-scale document processing, coding agents, and data agents ( OpenAI, 2025b ; Gemini, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Anthropic, 2025a ; Anysphere, 2025 ; GitHub, 2025 ) .
When processing large inputs, like code or long documents, experts readers skim to closely read only what matters.
Yet, transformers process every token of their input through each layer, whether or not the token bears critical information. The cost of this full read is attention compute that grows quadratically with input length, as well as MLP compute and KV-cache memory that grow linearly, making long-context prefill a key bottleneck in model serving.
blocks.zh:
长文输入支撑着最近令人振奋的语言模型部署,模型在推论中处理大量个性化用户数据和活性内容的能力导致在深入研究、大规模文件处理、编码代理和数据代理方面的变革能力(OpenAI,2025b;双子座2025;Anthropic,2025b;Anthropic,2025a;Anysphere,2025;GitHub,2025) 。
在处理大量输入,如代码或长文件时,专家读者会滑行,只仔细阅读重要的内容.
然而,变压器通过每一层处理其输入的每个符号,无论该符号是否包含重要信息. 这种全读的成本是随输入长度四倍增长的注意力计算,以及线性增长的MLP计算和KV-cache内存,使长写预填模型服务中的关键瓶颈.

(b) The gate module scores each hidden state with a small scoring network, and a top- K K selector forwards the kept hidden states together with their importance scores. (c) Token-gated attention multiplies each attention weight by the gate value g j g_{j} of its key, which enables end-to-end training. (d) On 2WikiMultihopQA question answering, with Qwen3-1.7B, TokenGate pushes the Pareto frontier of accuracy versus time-to-first-token and peak prefill memory; at 95 % 95\% of the full-context accuracy it prefills 3.0 × 3.0\times faster and with 2.7 × 2.7\times less memory, outperforming the best training-free token pruning methods, like FastKV ( Jo et al., 2025 ) and SlimInfer ( Long et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
Recent research proposes to address this efficiency challenge for long-context prefill through two primary approaches. First, one body of work proposes training-free token pruning , using attention-based scoring heuristics to prune token hidden states, forwarding only the highest-scoring tokens to upper layers ( Jo et al., 2025 ; Long et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) . These methods are inexpensive to deploy, requiring no model training, but demonstrate limited speedups before degrading accuracy.
Alternatively, a large body of work instead develops architectural modifications to the standard transformer architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . These methods offer promising prefill-efficiency improvements, but are expensive to train, often requiring pre-training from scratch and substantially different hardware and software than existing ecosystems ( Dehghani et al., 2018 ; Bae et al., 2025 ; Graves, 2016 ; Raposo et al., 2024 ; Ainslie et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2021 ; He et al., 2025 ; Gu & Dao, 2023 ; Dao & Gu, 2024 ) .
To bridge this gap, we ask the question, can we endow existing trained models with improved long-context prefill efficiency while maintaining strong accuracy?
blocks.zh:
最近的研究建议通过两种主要方法解决长文预填效率方面的挑战。 首先,有一套工作建议免培训的代币推算,使用基于注意力的计分heuristics来推算代币隐藏状态,只将最高的代币推向上层(Jo等人,2025年;Long等人,2025年;Jin等人,2025年;Shi等人,2025年)。 2024; Yang等人, 2024a; Fu等人, 2024; Chen等人, 2026; Wang等人, 2021 ). 这些方法的部署成本低廉,不需要模式培训,但在降低准确性之前显示速度有限。
或者,一大批工作正在对标准变压器建筑进行建筑改造(Vaswani等人,2017年)。 这些方法有希望提高填充前的效率,但培训费用昂贵,往往需要从零开始进行预训,而且硬件和软件与现有生态系统有很大不同(Dehghani等人,2018年;Bae等人,2025年;Graves等人,2016年;Raposo等人,2024年;Ainslie等人,2023年;Kim等人,2021年;He等人,2025年;Gu & Dao,2023年;Dao & Gu,2024年)。
为了弥补这一差距,我们提出一个问题,即我们能否在保持强烈准确性的同时,将经过培训的现有模型与改进的长文本预填效率结合起来?

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce TokenGate , a small, drop-in component that extends transformer-based models, enabling end-to-end trainable token pruning over long-context inputs for efficient prefill.
The model forward pass using TokenGate decomposes into three parts, as Figure 1 a shows. First, layers below the gate module perform a standard forward pass, processing all tokens through each layer. Second, tokens pass through the gate module, which produces a score for each token, retaining only the top- K K for continued processing. Third, the layers above the gate module process the selected tokens with token-gated attention , a mechanism that re-weights the attention computation using the generated importance scores. TokenGate reduces prefill compute and memory because pruned tokens are never forwarded through the post-gate layers and these layers never generate KV cache entries.
blocks.zh:
在这个作品中,我们引入了TokenGate(TokenGate),这是一个小型的即时组件,可以扩展基于变压器的模型,使端到端可列车的代币在长文本输入上进行浏览,以高效的预填.
如图1 a所示,使用TokenGate的模型前传分解为三部分. 首先,门舱下面的层进行标准前传,通过每层处理所有符号. 第二,令牌通过门舱,每个令牌产生分数,只保留上-K继续处理. 第三,闸门模块上方的层用符号加注的注意处理所选的符号,这个机制利用生成的重要性分数对注意力的计算进行重新加权. 键 门会减少预填计算和内存,因为pruned acidents从未通过后门层转发,这些层也从未生成KV缓存条目.

blocks.en:
Token pruning uses a non-differentiable top- K K operator, which presents a challenge for end-to-end learning. We introduce token-gated attention to overcome this issue.
Our method takes inspiration from Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) , which achieve sparsity over activated model parameters by gating expert sub-networks. We use a similar form, but instead weight attention logits to achieve sparsity over processed tokens . Using this technique, we demonstrate that we can adapt existing trained models with cost similar to standard adaptation techniques. For instance, we can fine-tune existing models with TokenGate using simple next-token-prediction loss, with no auxiliary loss and total train time similar to supervised fine-tuning on the base model. The resulting TokenGate model matches or exceeds accuracy over the trained base model, while significantly reducing prefill latency and memory.
blocks.zh:
Token pruning使用无差别的顶端-K K操作器,这为端到端的学习带来了挑战. 我们以象征性的关注来解决这一问题。
我们的方法从“专家混合”(MoE)(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年)中汲取灵感,通过Gaging专家子网络,这些模型在激活模型参数上实现了螺旋。 我们使用相似的形式, 利用这一技术,我们表明,我们可以以类似于标准适应技术的成本调整现有训练有素的模型。 例如,我们可以使用简单的下接模式预测损失,对TokenGate进行现有模型的微调,没有辅助损失,火车总时间类似于在基模型上监督的微调. 由此产生的TokenGate模型比训练有素的基础模型匹配或超过精度,同时大大减少了预填空闲和内存.

blocks.en: We evaluate TokenGate on diverse tasks, including code completion, multi-hop QA, multi-doc summarization, medical extraction, and needle-in-a-haystack, using both traditional transformer models and a recent hybrid attention one. Overall, we show the following findings (1) TokenGate reduces TTFT and peak prefill memory by 1.4 1.4 - 11.3 × 11.3\times and 1.5 1.5 - 3.4 × 3.4\times , respectively, at no accuracy degradation compared to the finetuned model baseline with full-context, and outperforms all training-free token pruning methods, by up to 6.4 × 6.4\times faster prefill (TTFT) and 2 × 2\times lower peak prefill memory relative to the next-best baseline, (2) TokenGate natively extends existing recent hybrid-attention architectures , like Qwen3.5-2B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , where it achieves 3.8 × 3.8\times lower TTFT over the full-context baseline at no accuracy degradation, and 2.1 × 2.1\times lower TTFT than the next best-performing token-pruning method at fixed accuracy. (3) Training models is efficient with TokenGate , incurring minimal overhead compared to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, like LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价TokenGate的多种任务,包括代码完成,多跳QA,多doc汇总,医疗提取,以及针入海斯塔克,同时使用传统的变压器模型和最近的混合关注模型. 总体而言,我们显示以下调查结果: (1)TokenGate将TTFT和峰值预填内存分别减少1.4 1.4 - 11.3 × 11.3\时和1.5 1.5 - 3.4 × 3.4\时,与全文本的微调模型基线相比,没有精度降解,并且比所有无训练的代币推算方法都好,比高6.4 × 6.4\时的预填(TTTFT)和高2 × 2\时的峰值预填内存比次优基准更低, (2)TokenGate本土扩展了现有的近期混合式代币结构,如Quen3.5-2B(Quen Team, 2026),在全文本基线上达到3.8 × 3.8\时的低 TTFTFT,在固定精度上比次优表现的代币推算法低2.1 2.11\时. (3) 培训模式与TokenGate(TokenGate)是高效的,与标准参数效率微调技术(如LORA(Hu等人,2021年))相比,产生的间接费用最低。

blocks.en:
Overall, we summarize our contributions as follows: • We introduce TokenGate , a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning for fast and memory-efficient prefill. • We propose token-gated attention , a mechanism for training models end-to-end despite the gate module’s non-differentiable top- K K operator. • Our systematic evaluation finds that TokenGate reduces TTFT and peak prefill memory by up to 6.4 × 6.4\times and 2 × 2\times , respectively, compared to the next best-performing baselines, TokenGate natively extends transformer-based models, including recent hybrid-attention architectures.
Further, training is efficient, with total train time comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,我们总结我们的贡献如下: 我们引入了TokenGate,这是一个小的、即时的组件,它扩展了现有的训练有素的模型,使得能够从端到端的可学习的符号循环用于快速和内存高效的预填。 我们建议给予象征性的注意,即一种培训模式端到端的机制,尽管门舱的顶端是无差别的K K操作员。 我们的系统评价发现,TokenGate将TTFT和峰值预填内存分别减少6.4×6.4\时和2×2\时,与次佳表现的基线相比,TokenGate本土扩展变压器的模型,包括最近的混合关注架构.
此外,培训效率很高,总列车时间与标准参数效率微调技术相当.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Training-free Token Pruning. One body of prior work optimizes prefill using training-free token-pruning methods (e.g., FastKV, SlimInfer, DASH, and GemFilter) ( Jo et al., 2025 ; Long et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) . These methods prune token hidden states at a mid-layer of the model using attention-based heuristics to rank tokens, forwarding only the highest-scoring tokens to upper layers of the model. This body of work is closest to ours, however, unlike our work, these methods are not trainable. As we observe in (Section 5 ), these methods offer limited speedups before degrading accuracy because they employ heuristic attention-based token-ranking functions that under-perform our end-to-end trained scoring network, and they prevent co-adaptation of the model backbone with the pruning function, which our end-to-end trainable design enables.
blocks.zh: 训练免费托肯普鲁宁. 先前的一组工作利用免训练的代币喷洒方法(如FastKV、SlimInfer、DASH和GemFilter)优化了预填(Jo等人,2025年;Long等人,2025年;Jin等人,2025年;Shi等人,2025年)。 2024; Yang等人, 2024a; Fu等人, 2024; Chen等人, 2026; Wang等人, 2021 ). 这些方法prune acident在模型的中层隐藏状态,使用基于注意力的heuristics来排序符号,仅将最高得分的符号转发给模型的上层. 然而,与我们的工作不同,这些方法不能训练。 正如我们在(第5节)中观察到的,这些方法在降低精确度之前提供有限的速度,因为它们采用了基于heuristic的注意的符号级函数,这些函数未很好地完成我们端到端训练的评分网络,并且它们防止模型主干线与普鲁恩函数协同适应,而我们的端到端训练设计能够实现这种功能.

blocks.en:
Architectural Modifications. Several lines of work explore architectural modifications to the self-attention-based transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , reducing the compute and memory of processing long-context inputs.
First, one body of work studies architectures that achieve adaptive compute per token through dynamic token routing or learned pruning decisions, but are expensive to train. These works require pre-training from scratch ( Dehghani et al., 2018 ; Bae et al., 2025 ; Graves, 2016 ; Raposo et al., 2024 ; Ainslie et al., 2023 ) or expensive fine-tuning with auxiliary loss terms that fix the token budget during train time, requiring re-training for each inference-time token budget ( Kim et al., 2021 ; He et al., 2025 ; Goyal et al., 2020 ; Rao et al., 2021 ) .
In contrast to all of these works, TokenGate natively extends popular pre-trained language models and is simple and efficient to train. We show that with a single fine-tuning pass, the resulting TokenGate model generalizes across input lengths and token budgets (Section 5 , Appendix D.3 ).
blocks.zh:
建筑改造. 多行工作探索对自留心式变压器进行建筑改造(Vaswani等人,2017年),减少了处理长文本输入的计算和内存.
第一,一套工作研究架构,通过动态符号路由或学习的修剪决定,实现每个符号的适应性计算,但训练费用昂贵. 这些工作需要从头开始进行预先培训(Dehghani等人,2018年;Bae等人,2025年;Graves,2016年;Raposo等人,2024年;Ainslie等人,2023年),或用昂贵的辅助损失条款进行微调,在列车时间确定象征性预算,要求每次推断时间象征性预算进行再培训(Kim等人,2021年;He等人,2025年;Goyal等人,2020年;Rao等人,2021年)。
与所有这些作品形成对比的是,TokenGate本土推广了流行的预训语言模型,并且简单高效的训练. 我们显示,通过一次微调,产生的TokenGate模式将输入长度和符号预算概括起来(第5节,附录D.3)。

blocks.en:
Other works on sub-quadratic architectures for language modeling introduce promising, new algorithms that reduce the per token compute and memory of attention operations, including new compute primitives and sparse attention mechanisms ( Gu & Dao, 2023 ; Dao & Gu, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024c ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Lai et al., 2025 ) .
However, unlike TokenGate , these architectures still process all tokens through each model layer.
In Section 5 we demonstrate TokenGate natively extends recent hybrid architectures with sub-quadratic layers ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and enables even more efficient prefill.

blocks.en: Conditional Computation. Mixture-of-experts layers achieve sparsity over the activated model parameters, making it possible to efficiently scale model capacity ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Our work is inspired by the success of this line of work, however, we focus on achieving sparsity over a different axis, the input context length, for scalable long-context prefill.
blocks.zh: 有条件计算. 专家混合层在激活的模型参数上实现螺旋性,从而有可能高效地扩大模型容量(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年;Liu等人,2024年)。 我们的工作受到这一条工作的成功的启发,然而,我们侧重于通过不同的轴线,即输入上下文长度,实现可伸缩的长文字预填。

blocks.en: Decode Optimizations. A large body of work targets the cost of decoding rather than prefill, evicting or merging KV-cache entries after prefill ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ; Ge et al., 2023 ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) , and performing early exit or per-token routing for decoded tokens ( Schuster et al., 2022 ; Elhoushi et al., 2024 ) . These methods do not improve prefill efficiency and are complementary to prefill optimizations like ours.

blocks.en:
TokenGate is a drop-in neural network component, which places a gate module within a specified transformer layer 1 1 1 The design generalizes to multiple gate modules at different layers, each selecting from the tokens kept by the layers below it and contributing to the token-gated attention in layers above. , L L , to score and prune tokens, as shown in Figure 1 .
In this section, we describe how TokenGate enables trainable token pruning using two key components, the gate module (Section 4.1 ) and token-gated attention (Section 4.2 ). We will then overview an end-to-end training recipe for adapting existing models (Section 4.3 ).

blocks.en: Overall, the full TokenGate forward pass with gating at layer L L decomposes into three phases. First, tokens pass through layers below the gate module, using a standard forward pass. Second, the gate module processes all tokens, producing a score for each, and selecting a subset to prune. Third, the model performs a pruned forward , processing only selected tokens in layers above the gate module, using token-gated attention , which re-weights attention scores using the importance scores. TokenGate reduces both the compute and memory footprint during prefill by preventing model layers after the gate module from processing pruned tokens or generating KV-cache entries for them.

blocks.en:
The gate module’s top- K K selector introduces a non-differentiability, creating a challenge for end-to-end learning. To overcome this challenge, we introduce token-gated attention , which integrates token importance scores generated by the gate module into upper model layers, providing a gradient path. Our method is inspired by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) .
In MoE, a router network weights the outputs of expert sub-networks to achieve sparsity over activated model parameters .
In contrast, token-gated attention re-weights attention logits
to achieve sparsity over processed tokens .

4.3 End-to-end Gate Training

blocks.en: Despite TokenGate ’s non-differentiable top- K K selection (Eq. 4 ), the task loss is a differentiable function of the scoring network, almost everywhere. This is due to token-gated attention, which injects the top- K K gate values into the attention logits at each layer above the token gate. When we choose K > 1 K>1 , the gate value g j g_{j} has non-zero derivatives with respect to the scoring network weights. This mirrors how the router is trained in MoE through its top- K K expert selection: the router’s value multiplies the output of each selected expert, just as our gate value multiplies the attention score of each selected token ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . Intuitively, a token whose additional attention mass lowers the task loss receives a larger score. A token that distracts receives a smaller one, allowing the scoring network to learn token importance. This mechanism allows TokenGate to be trained end-to-end jointly with the model backbone simply using standard task losses.

blocks.en: We evaluate the effectiveness of TokenGate on diverse tasks, including code completion, multi-hop QA, summarization, medical extraction, and needle-in-a-haystack. Overall, results demonstrate: • TokenGate reduces TTFT and peak prefill memory by 1.4 1.4 - 11.3 × 11.3\times and 1.5 1.5 - 3.4 × 3.4\times , respectively, at no accuracy degradation compared to the base model with full-context, and outperforms the next best-performing token pruning baselines by up to 6.4 × 6.4\times and 2 × 2\times , respectively. • TokenGate extends existing transformer-based models , including recent hybrid-attention architectures, achieving 3.8 × 3.8\times lower TTFT than the full-context baseline at no accuracy degradation and 2.1 × 2.1\times lower TTFT than the best prior methods, at fixed accuracy. • Training models with TokenGate is efficient, incurring minimal training overhead , with total training time comparable to standard parameter efficient fine-tuning.

We compare TokenGate against state-of-the-art token-pruning methods, FastKV ( Jo et al., 2025 ) , SlimInfer ( Long et al., 2025 ) , DASH ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and GemFilter ( Shi et al., 2024 ) , as well as sparse attention methods, FlexPrefill ( Lai et al., 2025 ) and MInference ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) . We train our model with TokenGate to convergence using the same LoRA configuration. We train both a standard transformer model, Qwen3-1.7B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and a hybrid architecture, Qwen3-2B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , each on 4 A100 GPUS.

blocks.en: 5.1 Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill
blocks.zh: 5.1 快速和内存有效预补

blocks.en:
We evaluate the prefill efficiency of models trained with TokenGate .
First, Figure 3 (top) shows the accuracy vs TTFT of each benchmarked method, demonstrating that across all datasets, the trained TokenGate model achieves pareto-optimal performance. Specifically, TokenGate reduces TTFT by 1.4 1.4 – 11.3 × 11.3\times at no accuracy degradation compared to standard prefill, and by 1.2 1.2 – 6.4 × 6.4\times compared to the next best-performing baseline. We measure FastKV, one of the best-performing baselines both at its default layer and at layer 1, the same layer index as the TokenGate . Notably, we observe that compared to FastKV (Layer 1), TokenGate significantly outperforms across all datasets, indicating the promise of end-to-end trainable token pruning for achieving prefill speedups.
blocks.zh:
我们评估了TokenGate训练的模型的预填效率。
首先,图3(上)显示每个基准方法的准确性与TTFT,表明在所有数据集中,训练有素的TokenGate模型都实现了pareto-opteral性能. 具体来说,TokenGate将TTFT比标准预填减少1.4 – 11.3 × 11.3\的精度降解,比次优表现基准减少1.2 1.2 – 6.4 × 6.4\的精度. 我们测量FastKV, 无论是在默认的地层还是在第1地层, 值得注意的是,我们观察到,与FastKV(Layer 1)相比,TokenGate在所有数据集的绩效都大大超过,表明实现预填速度的可端到端可列车标牌冲刺的承诺.

blocks.en:
Turning our attention to the bottom row of Figure 3 , we study the prefill memory footprint, reporting accuracy versus peak prefill memory. Once again, across all dataset, the TokenGate model establishes the Pareto-frontier, reducing peak memory by 1.5 1.5 – 3.4 × 3.4\times compared to standard prefill at matched accuracy. Moreover the TokenGate model achieves up to 2.1 × 2.1\times lower peak memory compared to the next best-performing baseline at matched accuracy.
Overall, the results demonstrate that TokenGate significantly outperforms prior token-pruning methods, offering an exciting direction for improved prefill efficiency.
blocks.zh:
将注意力转向图3的下行, 我们研究了预填内存足迹, 报告准确性与峰值预填内存。 在所有数据集中,TokenGate模型再次建立了Pareto-frontier,与标准预填精确度相比,峰值内存减少了1.5 – 3.4 × 3.4\时间. 此外,TokenGate模型的峰值内存最高可达2.1×2.1\时,与下个表现最佳的精确度基线相比较低。
总体来看,结果显示,TokenGate的绩效大大高于前期象征性推算方法,为提高预填效率提供了令人振奋的方向。

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation Study: Understanding the Performance of TokenGate Models
blocks.zh: 5.2 关联研究:了解托肯盖特模型的性能

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that TokenGate owes its superiority to end-to-end learnable token pruning.
Our visualizations of the kept tokens for real samples (Appendix E )
shows that TokenGate flexibly learns very different pruning patterns in a task-dependent manner,
ranging from keeping answer keywords for question answering to keeping stop-words at the ends of phrases for summarization (Figure 2 ).
To understand this more rigorously, we investigate two key mechanisms: trainable token-selection, and co-adaptation with the trained backbone.
blocks.zh:
我们假设TokenGate的优越性 归功于端到端的可学习的标志性搜索
我们对真实样本保存的标志的可视化(附录E)
显示TokenGate灵活地学习了与任务相依的非常不同的螺旋模式,
从保留答题关键词到保留句尾的句子以进行总结(图2 ).
为了更严格地理解这一点,我们调查了两个关键机制:可以训练的象征性选择,和与受过训练的骨干共同适应。

blocks.en: Trainable selector. First, to study the effectiveness of TokenGate ’s learned selector, we compare performance of the trained TokenGate model (Layer 1), to the same model with random token selection on 2WikiMultihopQA. Figure 5 , demonstrates that the trained selector significantly outperforms the random-K selector on accuracy across all token budgets. Moreover, we compare against the FastKV selector applied at the same layer, Layer 1, of the finetuned base model. Notably, the TokenGate selector significantly outperforms the FastKV selector. This result demonstrates the value of an end-to-end trained gate module for token pruning: the trained scoring network leads to far better token selection compared to FastKV, which relies on a heuristic using attention scores that offer only weak signal at early layers, resulting in accuracy degradation for aggressive pruning.
blocks.zh: 可训练选手. 首先,为了研究TokenGate所学选手的效能,我们将训练有素的TokenGate模型(Layer 1)的性能与2Wiki MultihopQA上的随机符号选择作比较. 图5显示,经过培训的选手在所有象征性预算中的准确度方面大大超过随机-K选手。 此外,我们比较了在微调基模型同一层第1层应用的FastKV选择器. 值得注意的是,TokenGate选择器的性能大大超过FastKV选择器. 这一结果证明了一个端到端训练的门模块对于符纹钻探的价值:经过训练的评分网络导致比FastKV更好的符纹挑取,它依赖于使用注意分的heuristic,在早期层只提供微弱的信号,导致攻击性的螺纹钻探的精度退化.

blocks.en: Co-adaptation. Secondly, we analyze the effect of co-adaptation for TokenGate , which allows the model backbone and gate module to co-adapt. We compare the performance of random-K selection over the TokenGate model to the random-K selection over the finetuned base model. Notably, with the same random-K selector, the TokenGate model still outperforms the fine-tuned model, achieving higher accuracy across all token budgets, as Figure 5 shows. This result shows that TokenGate ’s end-to-end training allows the model to become more robust to token-pruning, likely redistributing information among tokens.
blocks.zh: 共调适. 其次,我们分析TokenGate的协同适应效果,这使得模型骨干和门模块可以共同适应. 我们比较随机-K选择在TokenGate模型上的性能与随机-K选择在微调基模型上的性能. 值得注意的是,通过相同的随机-K选择器,TokenGate模型仍然优于微调模型,如图5所示,在所有符号预算中实现更高的精度. 这一结果表明,TokenGate的端到端培训使得该模型能够变得更强壮,以示纪念,有可能将信息重新分配给标志。

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that end-to-end training with TokenGate enables state-of-the-art prefill performance through two complementary mechanism: the effectiveness of the learned scoring network, and co-adaptation, which allows the model to adapt jointly with the gating module for improved robustness to token pruning.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示,与TokenGate进行的端到端培训通过两个互补机制使最新预填性能得以实现:学习的评分网络的有效性,以及协同适应,这使得该模型能够与配对模块共同适应,以提高稳健性,以进行象征性的挤压.

blocks.zh: 5.3 推广替代建筑

blocks.en: We evaluate how TokenGate ’s performance extends to a recent hybrid-attention model, Qwen3.5-2B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) model, which uses full-attention layers every fourth layer and a Gated-DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2024b ) for all other layer. We compare TokenGate against FastKV ( Jo et al., 2025 ) , the best-performing baseline in our main results (Section 5.1 ). We measure FastKV over the LoRA-tuned base model and the LoRA-tuned model with TokenGate , both at varying layers. FastKV uses an attention-based score function and natively applies only to full-attention layers (i.e., layer 3, 7, 11, etc). TokenGate natively extends both the full attention and Gated-DeltaNet layers, so we apply it over both. We provide further details on TokenGate for Qwen3.5 in Appendix C.4 .

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows the accuracy vs TTFT of both methods at varying layers on the NIAH 32K dataset, demonstrating that TokenGate ’s strong performance extends to the hybrid-attention model. TokenGate (Layer 3) matches the accuracy of standard prefill at 3.8 × 3.8\times lower TTFT, and 2.1 × 2.1\times lower TTFT than the best-performing FastKV run at the same accuracy.
Applying the TokenGate at the lower GatedDeltaNet layers (Layer 1,2) enable even higher TTFT reductions, up to 7.8 × 7.8\times faster prefill, at accuracy within 6 % 6\% of standard prefill, once again significantly outperforming FastKV.

blocks.en: 5.4 Gate Training Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.4 大门培训效率

blocks.en:
We evaluate overhead of training models with TokenGate compared standard models, both with LoRA fine-tuning ( r = 16 r=16 ).
Table 2 in Appendix D.1 compares both, reporting total training time in A100 hours and the average per-step time during training for each evaluated dataset.
Overall, we observe that a TokenGate step is slower by 1.3 × 1.3\times compared to the baseline due to its sampling at two token budgets per step. However, the TokenGate train runs converge after fewer steps on four of five tasks, leading to modestly reduced overall training time compared to the standard training.

我们与TokenGate比较了标准模型来评估培训模型的间接费用,这两个模型都是LORA微调(r=16r=16).

总体而言,我们发现,与基线相比,TokenGate步骤比每步两个象征性预算的取样速度慢1.3×1.3\。 然而,TokenGate列车在5项任务中,有4项任务步数较少,导致总体培训时间与标准培训相比略有缩短。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced TokenGate , a neural network component that extends existing trained transformer models, enabling end-to-end trainable token pruning using token-gated attention .
We demonstrate that that across diverse tasks, TokenGate reduces TTFT and peak prefill memory by up to 11.3 × 11.3\times and 3.4 × 3.4\times , respectively, at no accuracy degradation compared to standard prefill, and by up to 6.4 × 6.4\times and 2 × 2\times , respectively, compared to the best performing baselines.
Crucially, TokenGate is compatible with diverse transformer-based architectures, is simple to train, and incurs minimal training overhead, making it a promising drop-in replacement for standard fine-tuning over trained backbones.
In the future, we envision models trained with TokenGate will enable a broad range of applications, including medical extraction, deep research, and coding agents, where processing long-context inputs is critical, but currently prohibitively expensive.

在这部作品中, 我们引入了TokenGate, 一个神经网络组件, 扩展现有的训练有素的变压器模型,
我们证明,在各种任务中,TokenGate将TTFT和峰值预填内存分别减少最多11.3×11.3\时和3.4×3.4\时,与标准预填相比没有精确降解,与最佳表现基线相比分别减少最多6.4×6.4\时和2×2\时.
关键是,托肯 门与基于变压器的多样化建筑相兼容,训练简单,培训费用极少,使它成为对训练有素的骨干进行标准微调的有希望的倒置替代。
将来,我们设想与TokenGate一起培训的模型将使广泛的应用成为可能,包括医疗提取、深入研究和编码剂,其中处理长文输入至关重要,但目前费用高昂。

blocks.en: Appendix A Efficient kernels for TokenGate
blocks.zh: TokenGate 的高效内核

blocks.en: Token-gated attention (Eq. 8 ) differs from standard causal attention in two ways: a per-query temperature τ i ℓ ​ h \tau^{\ell h}_{i} and a per-key, per-head gate term added to the attention logits. The temperature is applied by scaling each query before the attention call, so it needs no kernel support. The gate term needs a per-key bias, which standard fused kernels do not accept, and unfused or score-modifying kernels are substantially slower. We therefore patch FlashAttention-2 ( Dao, 2023 ) to read a per-key, per-head bias vector, which it adds to each tile of attention scores before the online softmax. This keeps the fused structure of the kernel: the bias adds one vector load per key block, and a biased call costs 1.0 1.0 – 1.1 × 1.1\times a plain one. The kernel supports head dimensions 128 (Qwen3) and 256 (Qwen3.5).
blocks.zh: Token-gated attention(Eq. 8)在两个方面与标准因果注意不同:一个是每平滑温度 \ i l h \ tau^{\ell h}_{i}和一个每平滑,每头闸词添加到关注日志中. 温度通过在注意呼叫前缩放每个查询来应用,因此不需要内核支持. 闸门术语需要每个键的偏差,标准引信内核不接受这个偏差,未经引信或分数修改的内核则大大放缓. 因此,我们补丁FlashAttention-2(Dao,2023年)读取一个每键,每头偏差矢量,在网络软max之前,它会增加每片注意力分数. 这保持了内核的引信结构:偏差每个键块增加了一个矢量负载,偏差的调用成本为1.01.0–1.1×1.1\times a plain one. 内核支持头尺寸128(Quen3)和256(Quen3.5).

blocks.en:
Training. The same kernel provides the backward pass: the gradient of the bias of key j j is the sum over queries of the gradient of its attention scores, which the kernel accumulates alongside the usual gradients, so the task loss reaches the scoring network through the fused kernel. The two targets of each training step (Eq. 10 ) are packed into one variable-length call. For Qwen3.5, whose Gated DeltaNet layers are not supported by this path, we train with FlexAttention ( Dong et al., 2024 ) and add the bias as a score modification,
but more optimized kernels are possible.

blocks.en: Inference. Layers at and below the gate use the standard fused kernel (cuDNN on A100). The pruned forward of the post-gate layers is captured as one CUDA graph per padded length: the kept sequence is padded to a multiple of 64, and pad keys receive a bias of − 10 9 -10^{9} so the result is exact. The gather of the KV cache of layers ℓ ≤ L \ell\leq L to the kept tokens (Appendix B ) runs on a separate stream, concurrently with the post-gate layers. During decoding, the gate term of each kept key is fixed, so it is folded once into an additive attention mask per post-gate layer and decoding uses standard attention.

blocks.en: The layers above the gate, ℓ > L \ell>L , never compute KV entries for pruned tokens, so during decoding each new token attends there only to the kept tokens S S and the tokens generated so far. The layers at and below the gate, ℓ ≤ L \ell\leq L , process the full context during prefill, so by default their KV cache holds every context token, and decode tokens attend to the full context in these layers and to the pruned context above them. Optionally, TokenGate can also prune the cache of layers ℓ ≤ L \ell\leq L .

blocks.en: Appendix C Details of Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 附录C 实验设置的细节

blocks.en: C.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集

blocks.en: All datasets are evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B with greedy decoding for up to 1024 new tokens. Each model is fine-tuned on a training set that is disjoint from its evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 所有数据集在Qwen3-1.7B上通过贪婪的解码来评价,最高可达1024个新令牌. 每种模式都对一套与评价不相干的培训进行了微调。

blocks.en: RepoBench-P. RepoBench-P ( Liu et al., 2023 ) is a next-line code completion task. We use the LongBench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) version, whose prompts contain cross-file code context and an in-file prefix, and the model completes the next line. We evaluate on all 500 samples (mean context 11.0k tokens, up to 39k) and report edit similarity, 1 − Levenshtein / max ⁡ ( length ) 1-\mathrm{Levenshtein}/\max(\text{length}) , on the first generated line. For training, we use 14.9k samples from the RepoBench v1.1 Python and Java cross-file splits, deduplicated against the evaluation set.
blocks.zh: Repo Bench-P. Repo Bench-P(Liu等人,2023年)是下一行代码完成的任务. 我们使用Long Bench(Bai et al., 2024)版本,其提示包含交叉文件代码上下文和一个文件内前缀,模型完成下一行. 我们对所有500个样本(平均上下文为11.0k,最高39k)进行评估,并在第一个生成的行上报告编辑相似性,1 — Levenshtein / max(长度) 1-\mathrm{Levenshtein}/\max(文本{长) 。 为了训练,我们使用了来自Repo Bench v1.1 Python 和 Java 交叉文件的14.9k样本,与评价集相对照被复制.

blocks.en: 2WikiMultihopQA. 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) is a multi-hop question answering task over several Wikipedia passages; we use the LongBench version. We evaluate on all 200 samples (mean context 7.5k tokens) and report token-level F1 against the gold answers. For training, we use 20k 2WikiMultihopQA questions with contexts rebuilt from full Wikipedia articles and decontaminated against LongBench.
blocks.zh: 2 Wiki MultihopQA. 2 Wiki MultihopQA (英语). (Ho et al., 2020)是一个多跳问题解答任务,涉及多个维基百科段落;我们使用Long Bench版本. 我们对所有200个样本(平均7.5k令牌)进行评估,并对照黄金答案报告令牌级F1。 在训练方面,我们使用20k 2Wiki MultihopQA题,其背景从维基百科全文文章中重建,并对Long Bench进行消毒.

blocks.en: MultiNews. MultiNews ( Fabbri et al., 2019 ) is a multi-document news summarization task; we use the LongBench version. We evaluate on all 200 samples (mean context 2.7k tokens, up to 14k) and report ROUGE-L. For training, we use 44.8k samples from the MultiNews training split in the LongBench prompt format.
blocks.zh: MultiNews. MultiNews (Fabbri et al., 2019)是一个多文件新闻汇总任务;我们使用Long Bench版本. 我们对所有200个样本(平均上下文2.7k,最高14k)进行评估,并报告ROUGE-L. 在训练方面,我们使用从MultiNews训练中分解的44.8k样本,以LongBench 迅速格式进行.

blocks.en: BioDEX. BioDEX-Reactions ( D’Oosterlinck et al., 2023 ) is an adverse drug reaction extraction task over full-text biomedical papers: given a paper, the model lists the reported adverse reactions as MedDRA terms. We evaluate on 500 samples drawn from the official validation split with articles between 2k and 39k tokens (mean 4.5k), and report set F1 between predicted and gold reactions, counting a predicted reaction as correct if it matches a gold term up to substring containment. For training, we use 9.8k papers from the official training split.
blocks.zh: BioDEX. (英语). BioDEX-反应(Dosterlinck等人,2023年)是一份针对全文生物医学论文的不良药物反应提取任务:给一个论文,模型将所报告的不良反应列为MedDRA术语. 我们评价从官方验证中抽取的500个样本,用2k至39k令牌(平均4.5k)进行分解,并报告在预测反应和黄金反应之间设置了F1,如果与黄金术语相匹配,则计算出一个预测反应是否正确。 在训练方面,我们使用官方训练拆分的9.8k纸.

blocks.en: NIAH. NIAH ( Kamradt, 2023 ) is needle-in-a-haystack retrieval at 16k tokens. The haystack is built from Paul Graham essays, and the needle, “The best thing to do in city is activity .”, is inserted at a sentence boundary at a given depth; the model is then asked for the best thing to do in that city. The 200 evaluation samples cover 20 held-out cities at 10 depths evenly spaced from 0 to 1, and we report accuracy, i.e., whether the gold activity appears in the answer. For training, we use 12k generated samples with haystacks of 14k–16.4k tokens and uniformly random depths; the essays and cities are disjoint from the evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 尼亚赫。 NIAH(Kamradt,2023年)是针入海斯塔克的检索,收视量为16k令牌. 干草堆是用保罗·格雷厄姆的散文建造的,针头“城里最好的事就是活动......”插在某一深度的句子边界上;然后要求模型在该城市做最好的事。 200个评价样本覆盖了10个深度从0到1均匀的20个被搁置的城市,我们报告准确性,即金矿活动是否出现在答案中. 在训练方面,我们使用12k生成的样本,上面有14k–16.4k符号的干草堆和统一的随机深度;散文和城市与评价集脱节。

blocks.en: C.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: C.2 基线

blocks.en: All baselines run on the same SFT model, fine-tuned on each dataset with LoRA ( r = 16 r{=}16 , α = 32 \alpha{=}32 ) on the query and value projections of all layers. The pruning baselines keep all non-document tokens and prune only document tokens, with the same kept-token budgets K K as TokenGate ( 64 64 – 8192 8192 ). We briefly describe each baseline below, and the configurations used. We run each method, applying its optimization for prefill-only.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都运行在相同的SFT模型上,在每个数据集上与LORA(r = 16 r{=}16,α = 32\alpha{=}32)在所有层的查询和数值预测上进行微调. 推算的基线保留了所有非文件符号,而prune只保留文件符号,与TokenGate(64 64 – 8192 8192 )一样,保留了K K的预算。 我们简要描述以下每个基线以及所使用的配置。 我们运行每一种方法,将其优化为只预填.

blocks.en: FastKV ( Jo et al., 2025 ) . At a token-selective propagation layer, FastKV scores tokens by the attention they receive from a window of the last queries, max-pools the scores, and propagates only the top- K K tokens to deeper layers. We use the paper’s observation window of 8 tokens and pooling kernel of 7. We run it at layer 13 by default, following the paper and its hyper-parameter search, which chooses relative depth of 46 % 46\% for its models. We additionally run the baseline at layer 1, the layer at which we apply TokenGate , to compare performance at a matched layer index.
blocks.zh: FastKV(Jo等人,2025年). 在符号选择性传播层中,FastKV通过他们从最后一个查询窗口得到的注意来评分,最大将分数集合起来,并且只向更深层传播上-K符号. 我们使用纸上的8个符号的观察窗口和7的内核集合. 我们默认在13层运行, 遵循纸张及其超参数搜索, 它选择相对深度 46% 46%的模型。 我们额外运行了第1层的基线,即我们应用TokenGate的层,以比较相应的层指数的性能。

blocks.en: SlimInfer ( Long et al., 2025 ) . SlimInfer prunes hidden states in several stages: at layers 8, 17 and 25 it keeps 3 ​ K 3K , 1.5 ​ K 1.5K and K K tokens, scoring 64-token blocks by the attention of the last 4 queries. We use the paper’s block size, kernel and layer schedule, and its budget ratios, following the paper’s hyperparameter search.

blocks.en: GemFilter ( Shi et al., 2024 ) . GemFilter runs the first layers on the full prompt, selects the top- K K tokens by the last query’s attention scores at a filter layer, and then runs a fresh forward pass over only the selected tokens. We use filter layer 12, at the same relative depth (0.4) as recommended by the original paper, and the official pooling kernel.
blocks.zh: GemFilter (Shi等人, 2024). GemFilter 在全速率上运行第一层,在过滤层中通过最后一个查询的注意分数选择顶端的 K 令牌,然后运行一个仅通过所选令牌的新前传. 我们使用过滤层12,与原纸推荐的相对深度(0.4)相同,使用官方集合内核.

blocks.en: DASH ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . DASH halts tokens whose representations have stabilized: at layer 11 ( 0.4 × 0.4\times the number of layers, the official default), it ranks tokens by the change in their hidden state from the previous layer and drops the most stable ones, keeping K K document tokens.
blocks.zh: DASH(Chen等人,2026年). DASH停止表示已稳定表示的符号:在第11层(0.4×0.4\时为层数,正式默认值),它根据它们从上层隐藏状态的变化排列符号,并降下最稳定的符号,保留KK文档符号.

blocks.en: FlexPrefill ( Lai et al., 2025 ) . FlexPrefill is a sparse-attention method: it keeps all tokens but computes a query-adaptive sparse attention pattern during prefill, controlled by a cumulative-attention threshold γ \gamma . We use the official kernel and its recommended hyperparameters (divergence threshold τ = 0.1 \tau{=}0.1 , which decides per head whether to use a query-aware or a vertical-slash pattern; minimum budget 1024; block size 128) and sweep γ ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , … , 0.9 , 0.95 , 0.97 } \gamma\in\{0.1,0.2,\dots,0.9,0.95,0.97\} , extending the range until accuracy degrades.
blocks.zh: FlexPrefill(Lai等人,2025年). FlexPrefill是一种稀疏的注意方法:它保存所有符号,但在预填时计算出一个可调试的稀疏注意模式,由累积注意阈值 γ\gamma控制. 我们使用官方内核及其推荐的超参数(潜水阈值 \ = 0.1\tau{=}0.1),它决定每头是使用一个查询知觉还是垂直斜拉图;最低预算 1024;块大小 128),并扫射 { { 0.1, 0.2, 0.9, 0.95, 0.97}\gamma\in 0.1, 0.2,\dots,0.9,0.95,0.97\},将范围延长至精度下降.

blocks.en: MInference ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) . MInference uses per-head sparse attention patterns found by an offline search, which for Qwen3-1.7B selects vertical-and-slash patterns for all heads. We run the official implementation with patterns searched on Qwen3-1.7B, and sweep its budget by scaling the vertical and slash sizes of the searched configuration by { 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 , 2 , 4 } \{0.25,0.5,1,2,4\} , which keeps the searched pattern shape.

blocks.en: Implementation and timing. All methods run the same fine-tuned backbone in bf16 with the LoRA adapter folded into the weights, and all dense decoder layers are torch.compile d. Dense causal attention uses the same fused kernel in every lane (cuDNN on the A100; FlashAttention-2 on Qwen3.5-2B); the only kernel that differs is in the TokenGate ’s post-gate layers, which require a per-key bias and use a FlashAttention-2 variant at 1.0 1.0 – 1.1 × 1.1\times the cost of a plain call (Appendix A ). FastKV and GemFilter run through the compiled layers directly. The official SlimInfer and DASH prefills bypass the compiled layer forward, so we reimplemented both in compile-friendly form and verified that they select the same tokens as the official code (DASH bit-identical; SlimInfer identical selection), which made them 1.2 1.2 – 2.4 × 2.4\times and 1.25 1.25 – 1.56 × 1.56\times faster; we report the faster versions. MInference is compiled around its sparse kernel with identical accuracy, and FlexPrefill runs eager, its fastest configuration, since its data-dependent block selection triggers recompilation under torch.compile . The pruned forward of the TokenGate and of FastKV is captured as one CUDA graph per padded length; the remaining baselines have no fixed-shape pruned phase to capture. Both FastKV and the TokenGate optionally prune the KV cache of the layers below their pruning layer to the selected tokens once prefill completes, so that decoding holds K K entries at every layer; we disable this setting for both in all experiments since KV cache pruning presents an orthogonal set of optimizations and our experiments instead isolate the effect of token pruning for prefill optimization (Appendix B ). Inference timings are measured at batch size of 1 on one A100.

blocks.en: We study the ability of the trained TokenGate to extrapolate to inference settings with longer context. We take the fine-tuned base model and TokenGate model, both trained on the 16k-NIAH task using Qwen1.7B, and we evaluate prefill performance on the NIAH task with 32k, 64k and 128k-length test sets. Table 3 shows the TTFT speedups and peak memory reductions of the TokenGate model at no accuracy degradation over the full at full-context accuracy on each dataset. The results demonstrate that TokenGate extrapolates across varying context lengths at inference, retaining accuracy with greater than 11.3 11.3 - 13 × 13\times speedups. We observe that the TTFT speedups of the trained TokenGate model are highest at the longest context-length ranges, where trainable token pruning can significantly reduce costs. Meanwhile, the peak memory reduction is consistent across all length ranges, as expected, since peak memory is dominated by memory footprint of the standard forward that occurs without pruning in layers below the gate.
blocks.zh: 我们研究训练有素的TokenGate在较长的语境中推断推论环境的能力. 我们采用微调的基础模型和TokenGate模型,两者都使用Quen1.7B对16k-NIAH任务进行训练,我们用32k,64k和128k长的测试集来评价NIAH任务预填性能. 表3显示TTFT加速和TokenGate模型的峰值内存减量,没有以每个数据集的全文本精度在全文本上发生精度降解. 结果显示,TokenGate在推断时对不同上下文长度进行推算,保留准确度大于11.3 11.3 - 13 × 13\时速. 我们观察到,训练有素的TokenGate模型的TTFT加速速度在最长的上下文长度范围内最高,在此可训练的代币钻探可以显著降低成本. 同时,峰值内存的减少在所有长度范围内都是一致的,正如预期的一样,因为峰值内存以标准前方的内存足迹为主,没有在门下层进行挤压.

blocks.en: In this section we ablate the TokenGate design (Section 4 ). First, Figure 7 (left) compares the accuracy vs TTFT performance of TokenGate on BioDEX with Qwen3-1.7B against three variants: (a) removing the full-context loss term L K full L_{K_{\mathrm{full}}} from the per-step loss (Eq. 10 ), (b) removing the temperature scaling term during token-gated attention, and (c) removing the head-wise scaling. The results demonstrate that training without the full-context loss most significantly degrades inference accuracy at full-context, and removing the temperature scaling and head-wise gain also degrades accuracy, leading to sub-optimal accuracy vs TTFT.

blocks.en: We additionally analyze layer selection, a hyperparameter for TokenGate . Figure 7 (right) shows performance on BioDEX of Qwen3-1.7B models trained with the TokenGate at Layer 0, 1, and 2. Notably, the model with gating at Layer 0 is Pareto-suboptimal relative to the Layer 1 and 2 gate models, suggesting that the Layer 0 post-attention residuals provide insufficient signal for the TokenGate scoring network. On the other hand, the Layer 1 and Layer 2 TokenGate models both lie along the Pareto frontier, suggesting that by Layer 1, the post-attention residuals passed to the gate module are sufficiently rich to learn an effective scoring network for trainable token pruning.

blocks.en: What is kept, and what it costs. Table 4 summarizes the five examples. On 2WikiMultihopQA, BioDEX and NIAH the gate keeps content: entities and years, the terms that describe a medical case, and, where the reference answer occurs verbatim in the context, a large share of its tokens (all of the needle’s answer on NIAH). On RepoBench-P the selection is instead dominated by code structure: most kept tokens contain no letter, and they are spread thinly over the retrieved files, whereas on NIAH most kept tokens have a kept neighbor and form contiguous spans. This suggests that for code completion the post-gate layers use the kept tokens more as anchors on the structure of the retrieved files than as a copy of their content. The examples also show where pruning costs accuracy: on MultiNews the gate keeps mostly function words and under-keeps capitalized tokens, and the summary at K = 256 K=256 reports the right events but gets the names and places wrong, and for drug reaction extraction on BioDEX the pruned model recovers one of the two reactions found with the full context.
